description: This file defines the NewsRepository class responsible for fetching news articles from an external API client. It acts as an intermediary between the API client and the rest of the application, providing a method to retrieve top headlines based on country and category.

classes.name: NewsRepository
classes.description: A class that provides methods to retrieve news articles from an external news API, encapsulating the API client.

methods.name: getNews
methods.description: Fetches top headlines for a specified country and category using the API client.
